name: get_thread_area
description: The get_thread_area() system call provides architecture-specific support for thread-local storage. On x86, it reads the GDT entry specified by u_info->entry_number and fills in the user_desc structure. It is available on architectures like m68k and x86 for retrieving thread-local storage information.

parameters.name: u_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a user_desc structure where the GDT entry information is stored

return_value.success: Returns 0 on success for x86, or the thread area pointer value on m68k
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, with errno set to indicate the error

errors.description: get_thread_area() was invoked as a 64-bit system call
A free TLS entry could not be located (though primarily for set_thread_area)

bugs: On 64-bit kernels before Linux 3.19, setting certain padding bits in user_desc could prevent a TLS entry from being cleared properly. Additionally, prior to Linux 3.19, the DS and ES segment registers must not reference TLS entries.
